title: ジャパンCの後に・25光年を超えて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega rises to the top, sweeping the fierce international competition and toppling the Centurial Overlord and Doto's raging tempest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing this, Narita Top Road vows to make a comeback and beat Admire Vega herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega returns to me, the trainer who chose to follow her, as an unrivaled first-magnitude star.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She remarks how I've always been there for her, with the faintest of smiles on her face.
